codebook_evidence.title: Grand total
codebook_evidence.long_description: Grand total men and women enrolled for credit CREDIT - Recognition of attendance or performance in an instructional activity (course or program) that can be applied by a recipient toward the requirements for a degree, diploma, certificate, or other formal award. NOTE: Enrollment reported is of the institution's official fall reporting date or October 15.

codebook_evidence.title: Level of student
codebook_evidence.long_description: Level of student Undergraduate A student enrolled in a 4- or 5-year bachelor's degree program, an associate's degree program, or a vocational or technical program below the baccalaureate. Degree/certificate-seeking students Students enrolled in courses for credit who are recognized by the institution as seeking a degree or other formal award. At the undergraduate level, this is intended to include students enrolled in vocational or occupational programs First-time student (undergraduate) A student who has no prior postsecondary experience (except as noted below) attending any institution for the first time at the undergraduate level. Includes students enrolled in academic or occupational programs . Also includes students enrolled in the fall term who attended college for the first time in the prior summer term, and students who entered with advanced standing (college credits earned before graduation from high school). Institutions that do not have a standard fall term should consider all students entering the institution between August 1 and October 31 as first-time students, provided they have no previous postsecondary experience. Transfer-in degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students - Degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students entering the reporting institution for the first time but known to have previously attended a postsecondary institution at the undergraduate level. These students may or may not have transferred credit(s). Non-degree/certificate-seeking undergraduates - Examples of non-degree/certificate-seeking students would be high school students enrolled in creditable courses prior to high school graduation, or those enrolled in creditable courses who for some reason are not seeking a degree/certificate. Graduate student A student who holds a bachelor's or first-professional degree, or equivalent, and is taking courses at the post-baccalaureate level. These students may or may not be enrolled in graduate programs . First-professional student A student enrolled in any of the following degree programs : Chiropractic (D.C. or D.C.M.) Dentistry (D.D.S. or D.M.D.) Law (L.L.B., J.D.) Medicine (M.D.) Optometry (O.D.) Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) Podiatry (D.P.M., D.P., or Pod.D.) Theology (M.Div., M.H.L., B.D., or Ordination) Veterinary Medicine (D.V.M.)

codes.value_label: All students, Undergraduate, Other degree/certifcate-seeking, Transfer-ins
